security_implications: This chunk integrates several security-critical components. The error checker (kmac_errchk) monitors configuration mode, strength, unsupported combinations, and life cycle escalation to detect misuse. The entropy module, with its EDN handshake, provides masking for cryptographic operations; when EnMasking=0 it is bypassed and all entropy outputs are forced to zero. Shadowed register update errors are immediately mapped to the recoverable alert (alert_recov_operation). The unused_cfg_shadowed_qe signal XORs all shadowed qe bits but is unused, potentially missing an integrity check. lc_escalate_en[4] and [5] connect the life cycle controller to the error checker and entropy modules, respectively, enabling reactive security measures. The sha3_done signal is protected by a mubi4 sender to avoid signal-level faults. Any failure in these connections could lead to undetected misconfiguration, weak masking, or missed escalations.
